text:
yara: quick ping / short thread: we ran an adaptive-sparsity + early-stop heuristic canary on a tiny ded pool this morning. results look solid, posting summary and next steps. :rocket:

felix: TL;DR?

yara: TL;DR: median latency down ~16%, p95 down ~9%, p99 flat, token cost down ~33% on gen-heavy profiles. throughput +18% overall.

raj: bench output + flags pls.

yara: bench (pool: gd-dedicated-small, model: rw-7b-econ):

```
ADAPTIVE-SPARSITY CANARY - 2026-03-25 08:30 UTC
Model: rw-7b-econ
Profile: 75% gen, 25% chat
Baseline: p50=74ms p95=215ms p99=330ms tokens/s=920 cost=$0.0124/1k
Canary (adaptive-sparsity + early-stop): p50=62ms p95=196ms p99=332ms tokens/s=1084 cost=$0.00832/1k
Delta: p50 -16.2% p95 -8.8% p99 +0.6% throughput +17.8% unit-cost -32.9%
Notes: early-stop reduces wasted decode tokens on low-entropy tails; sparsity reduces compute for inner layers without quality drift on eval set A.
```

infra-bot: canary health: latency checks ok, error-rate=0.11%, memory stable.

felix: any quality regressions on eval sets?

yara: eval-set-A (prod-like prompts) shows BLEU/ROUGE drift <0.3% and human eval no clear regressions. we've pinned a rollback threshold for any metric delta >1.0%.

raj: edge cases? long reasoning chains? safety prompts?

yara: long chains (>3k tokens) see slightly higher decision variance; we will gate early-stop for seq_len>3200. safety prompts unaffected.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-4999 "Expose adaptive-sparsity cost delta and early-stop toggle in Console" assigned to felix. https://rwinf.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4999

sales-amy: good to know for customer conversations. can we get per-customer estimated savings?

felix: ops will add a per-route projection card (est 2d).

yara: rollout plan: expand to 30% traffic tonight, monitor 6h, 70% tomorrow AM if green, full by tomorrow evening. runtime flags: adaptive_sparsity=true, early_stop.enabled=true, early_stop.threshold=0.85, seq_gate=3200.

raj: rollback options?

yara: rollback via config API or console toggle: set adaptive_sparsity=false or early_stop.enabled=false for pool. quick curl: 

```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/internal/pools/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"pool":"gd-dedicated-small","flags":{"adaptive_sparsity":false,"early_stop.enabled":false}}'
```

felix: adding alert for p95 regressions and quality-drift >0.5% over 30min window.

infra-bot: dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/canaries/adaptive-sparsity-3032100000

sales-amy: thanks team! draft note for sales with projected savings pls. :tada:

yara: will draft short blurb and post to #releases after 70% stability.
